title: ping_l2: validate 7/7 on heft after re-provision fix (blocked by mid-merge conflict markers)
description: Follow-up from 5fva.1 (commit 84908feee9 on beads-worker-3). Root cause chain: (1) lichen_l2 disable/enable wipes link_ctx by design (rwio.1) and the suite never re-provisioned after reinit cycles -> -ENOKEY on all post-reinit TX tests; fixed with reprovision_after_reinit() after both net_if_up sites. (2) Setup loaded a legacy LLSec link key, but lichen_link_tx rejects E=1 keyed TX outright (2auf.21) -> -EPROTONOSUPPORT(-93); removed from setup + helper. Partial validation on heft worktree: 4/7 -> 5/7 after (1) alone. Remaining: rebuild+run with 84908feee9 applied, expect 7/7. BLOCKER: west anchors lichen module sources to ~/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN (main checkout) even when building from a worktree, and that checkout currently has unresolved conflict markers (lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/schc.c:558+, lichen/include/lichen/lora_compat.h) from another agent's merge — coordinate with sync-janitor bead project-LICHEN-worker6-ba39 before validating. Note: lichen_util.h ENOENT strerror case lives in module path, so it needs the main checkout healthy (or build with ZEPHYR_EXTRA_MODULES override) to take effect.
close_reason: VALIDATED: ping_l2 native_sim on heft — 7/7, 'PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL' (observed this session, fresh run after the final fix). Full fix chain, all committed on beads-worker-3: 84908feee9 (post-reinit key re-provision + drop legacy LLSec key), 237dc35064 (tx frame buffer capacity), 24cde81e5a (canonical key-derived peer EUI-64), cf9afa78a1 (one-shot loopback arming), 75b86d62cd (monotonic nonce stream: boot-epoch latch + stream checkpoint). The mid-merge conflict-marker blocker in this bead's description was transient (heft main healthy since). Each fix individually reviewed (3x kimi-k3 passes per round) and validated incrementally (3/7 -> 4/7 -> 5/7 -> 6/7 -> 7/7). Note for CI: the fixes live on beads-worker-3 pending merge; Twister/AWS re-validation happens at merge time per the normal flow. Parent 5fva and children .1/.2/.3 remain open — their failure modes are all covered by this chain and can be closed on review of these commits.
